note: R5.5 — the regression corpus for the zero-questions rules. `mustFail` are real clarifying questions; `mustPass` are rhetorical near-misses a builder legitimately writes. A rule change is only permitted alongside a new entry here, a docs/decisions.md entry and a full rerun; the corpus is what stops a loosening from going unnoticed.
